label: Window title
help: Custom text for the window title bar; empty uses the default name.

label: Window border width
help: Thickness of the border drawn around the window and each graph.

label: Orientation
help: Stack the graphs top to bottom, or left to right.

label: Window level
help: Whether the window joins the normal window order or floats above everything.

label: Stick to screen edges
help: Snap the window to the edge of the screen when it is moved within 5 pixels.

label: Drop shadow
help: Draw a shadow under the window.

label: Expand on hover
help: Automatically expand the collapsed window when the pointer enters it.

label: Bring to front when expanding
help: Also bring the window to the foreground when hover expansion opens it.

label: Show summary when collapsed
help: Show summary statistics in the window while it is collapsed.

label: Collapse towards
help: The edge the window keeps fixed while it is collapsed.

label: Window opacity
help: How opaque the dashboard window is; requires a compositing desktop.

label: Graph width
help: The minimum width each graph is given in the dashboard.

label: Hide the dock icon
help: Run without a dock icon; show it again from the menu bar item.

label: Check for updates on launch
help: Look for a new version every time the app starts.

label: Check for updates
help: Check for a new version right now.

label: Reset General to defaults
help: Restore every General setting to its default, after confirmation.

label: Anti-aliasing
help: Smooth the graph drawing.

label: Display effect
help: The drawing effect applied to every graph.

label: Window background color
help: The window background color as red, green, blue and opacity.

label: Window background opacity
help: How opaque the window background color is.

label: Graph background color
help: The graph background color as red, green, blue and opacity.

help: How opaque the graph background color is.

help: How opaque the series 2 color is.

help: How opaque the series 3 color is.

label: Border opacity
help: How opaque the border color is.

label: Text color

label: Text opacity
help: How opaque the text color is.

label: Graph font
help: The font used for graph labels, as a name and a size.

help: Restore every Appearance setting to its default, after confirmation.

label: Graph refresh interval
help: How often the graphs sample the system.

help: The height used by graphs that do not set their own.

label: Fast bars
help: Sample the CPU more often for a more immediate bar, at some cost in performance.

label: Separate curve colors
help: Color system, user and nice CPU time separately.

label: Show temperature
help: Show a temperature readout in the CPU graph.

label: Show average usage
help: Show the average CPU use over the visible window.

label: Show uptime
help: Show system up time in the CPU graph.

label: Show load average
help: Show the load average in the corner of the CPU graph.

label: Plot mode
help: What the GPU graph draws.

label: Show paging graph
help: Draw the memory paging status as a graph.

label: Battery history
help: What the battery graph records.

label: Temperature units
help: The units temperatures are displayed in.

label: Display mode
help: How the receive and send curves are arranged.

label: Total since boot
help: Show the bytes moved since the machine was last booted.

label: Total since launch
help: Show the bytes moved since XRG-ng was launched.

label: Minimum scale
help: A floor for the network graph's vertical scale; 0 lets it autoscale.

label: Display mode
help: How the read and write curves are arranged.

label: Reset Graphs to defaults
help: Restore every Graphs setting to its default, after confirmation.

label: CPU
help: Which logical CPU the CPU graph plots; empty is all CPUs.

label: GPU
help: Which GPU the GPU and VRAM graphs read; empty is automatic.

label: Intel Xe PMU activity
help: Read Intel Xe engine counters; this can keep the GPU awake.

label: Network interface
help: Which interface the network graph watches; empty is all of them.

label: Disk
help: Which disk the disk graph watches; empty is all of them.

label: VRAM curve 1
help: The source drawn as VRAM curve 1; empty is automatic.

label: VRAM curve 2
help: The source drawn as VRAM curve 2; empty is automatic.

label: VRAM curve 3
help: The source drawn as VRAM curve 3; empty is automatic.

label: Fans curve 1
help: The fan drawn as curve 1; empty is automatic.

label: Fans curve 2
help: The fan drawn as curve 2; empty is automatic.

label: Fans curve 3
help: The fan drawn as curve 3; empty is automatic.

label: Sensor 1
help: The sensor drawn as temperature curve 1; empty is none. Pickers group sensors as identified, unidentified and suspected unused.

label: Sensor 2
help: The sensor drawn as temperature curve 2; empty is none. Pickers group sensors as identified, unidentified and suspected unused.

label: Sensor 3
help: The sensor drawn as temperature curve 3; empty is none. Pickers group sensors as identified, unidentified and suspected unused.

label: Show unknown sensors
help: Include sensors without a known name in the temperature pickers.

label: Reset Sources to defaults
help: Restore every Sources setting to its default, after confirmation.

label: Track usage
help: Count AI tokens as they are used.

label: Daily token budget
help: Warn when this many tokens are used in a day; 0 is no limit.

label: Budget alert at
help: The share of the daily budget that triggers a notification.

label: Send desktop budget alerts
help: Raise a desktop notification when the budget threshold is reached.

label: Show token rate
help: Show tokens per second in the graph.

label: Show model breakdown
help: Break usage down by model and provider in the graph.

label: Track Claude
help: Read usage from local Claude data.

label: Track Codex
help: Read usage from local Codex data.

label: Track Gemini
help: Read usage from local Gemini data.

label: Track Hermes
help: Read usage from local Hermes data.

label: Track Ollama
help: Read the local Ollama model inventory.

label: Claude source
help: Where Claude usage is read from.

label: Claude logs
help: Empty uses the default location.

label: Claude database
help: Empty uses the default location.

label: Codex logs
help: Empty uses the default location.

label: Gemini logs
help: Empty uses the default location.

label: Hermes database
help: Empty uses the default location.

label: Metrics URL
help: A loopback HTTP address that reports token metrics.

label: Ollama URL
help: A loopback HTTP address running Ollama.

label: Reset AI to defaults
help: Restore every AI setting to its default, after confirmation.

label: Enable station weather
help: Fetch observations from a METAR station; this uses the network.

label: ICAO station
help: The four-character station code to report, for example KSEA.

label: Refresh
help: How often the station is polled.

label: Unit system
help: The default for the unit choices below.

label: History window
help: How far back the weather graph reaches.

label: Secondary curve
help: The observation drawn as a second curve.

label: Reset Weather to defaults
help: Restore every Weather setting to its default, after confirmation.

label: Stock symbols
help: Comma-separated ticker symbols to graph.

label: Time frame
help: How much history the chart shows.

label: Show last day change
help: Use twice as many lines to show the last day's change.

label: Show DJIA
help: Add the Dow as a secondary curve and closing price.

label: Reset Stocks to defaults
help: Restore every Stocks setting to its default, after confirmation.

label: Color theme
help: The built-in palette in use, or Custom when the colors were edited.

label: Theme name
help: The name the theme is saved and exported under.

label: Import theme
help: Load a .xtf or .json theme file.

label: Export theme
help: Save the current colors and opacity as a theme file.

label: Reset Themes to defaults
help: Restore every Themes setting to its default, after confirmation.
